brief:
The team behind the award-winning documentary NAZA said they consulted more than 100 sources while investigating Israeli military targeting policies in Gaza, The Guardian reported. The filmmakers pushed back against efforts by the Israeli Defense Forces to discredit their exposure of military systems and alleged acceptance of high civilian casualties.

The documentary details the Israeli military's targeting practices in Gaza and examines its stated policies regarding civilian harm during operations in the territory.
